title: Meditation Timing Drift Across the Week
dataSources: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`).
app: Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=meditation:session
| eval session_hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H")), day=strftime(_time,"%a")
| stats avg(session_hour) as avg_hour, avg(minutes) as avg_minutes, count as sessions by day
| sort day
description: Shows whether meditation is anchored to a stable time of day or keeps drifting later in the week.
value: A habit tied to a reliable time usually survives busy weeks better than one that keeps sliding around.
implementation: Ingest meditation sessions with durations; review average session time and duration by weekday.
visualization: Table of weekdays with average meditation start hour and minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It warns when your meditation time keeps drifting later in the week, which is often how a good habit starts to wobble.
